findings.description: The inline policy grants unrestricted EC2, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch actions against all resources. This violates least privilege and permits broad access to data and infrastructure, including service-mediated privilege escalation opportunities where those actions support them.

The access-key secret material is exported through a Terraform output without `sensitive = true`, so it can be displayed in Terraform CLI output and automation logs. Although the value is named `encrypted_secret`, no PGP key is configured on the access key, so it is not substantiated as encrypted secret material in this configuration.
